exposure: bladder neck position during maximal Valsalva
cohort: 447 primiparous women who delivered at Zhejiang Hospital and completed follow-up at 6-8 weeks postpartum.
finding: A nomogram integrating clinical and sonographic variables demonstrated excellent discriminative ability (AUC 0.93) for predicting postpartum stress urinary incontinence in primiparous women.
mod_finding: Operative vaginal delivery was identified as an independent predictor of postpartum stress urinary incontinence.
